about: The Outdoors app lists the city's beaches; going to the nearest puts you on the sand by the sea, with the sea and sand from the air. Run in Accra or Lagos (game.city/area, or --q).

steps.log: (() => { const b = window.__bw.look.outdoors.beaches()[0], p = window.__bw.player; return { at: [Math.round(p.x), Math.round(p.z)], toBeach: Math.round(Math.hypot(p.x - b.x, p.z - b.z)) }; })()

steps.expect: (() => { const b = window.__bw.look.outdoors.beaches()[0], p = window.__bw.player; return Math.hypot(p.x - b.x, p.z - b.z) < 80; })()
steps.name: you are at the beach (within 80 m of the water's edge)

steps.eval: (() => { const b = window.__bw.look.outdoors.beaches()[0], c = window.__bw.cam; c.yaw = c.yawT = Math.atan2(-b.sea.x, -b.sea.z); })()
